description: This file defines the WorkShiftDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for handling CRUD operations and queries related to WorkShift entities, including fetching, counting, saving, updating, and deleting work shifts, as well as managing employee associations within those shifts.

classes.name: WorkShiftDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling operations related to WorkShift entities, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion, along with associated employee management.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Fetches a WorkShift entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingWorkShiftIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing work shift IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of WorkShift entities based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object for paginating through work shift entities matching search criteria.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of WorkShift entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveWorkShift
methods.description: Saves a WorkShift entity and its associated employee work shifts within a transaction.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Associates employees to a work shift by creating EmployeeWorkShift entities.

methods.name: updateWorkShift
methods.description: Updates a work shift with new employee associations, managing deletions and additions.

methods.name: getEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities associated with a specific work shift ID.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employee-work shift associations for specific employees within a particular work shift.

methods.name: deleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Deletes work shifts specified by their IDs.
